phase_policies.applies_when: At the start of the game, both players are in a ground macro posture with heavy economy and expansion, light technology, and moderate production. The opponent is likely to have Zerglings and Queens, with possible early pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have secured your natural expansion and have a few Queens and Zerglings. If the opponent shows signs of heavy aggression, adjust by building more defensive units.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on economy and expansion, maintain ground army, light defense, produce Queens and Zerglings.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your economy and expansion while strengthening your ground army. Keep your defense light but be ready to react to early pressure. Continue producing Queens and Zerglings to maintain safety.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Economy and Safety
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy at the expense of neglecting early defense; ensure you have sufficient Queens and Zerglings to fend off early aggression.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the early-midgame, both players are still in a ground macro posture with heavy economy and expansion, but technology is starting to increase. The opponent may have Zerglings and Queens, with possible pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a few tech structures started and your economy is still strong. If the opponent is teching to air, consider preparing anti-air.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and production, maintain ground army, consider tech, light defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and production. Maintain your ground army and consider increasing your technology. Keep your defense light but be ready to react to pressure.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production while teching; maintain a moderate ground force to deter attacks and ensure safe tech investment.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the midgame, the opponent has a heavy ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, and heavy production and technology. You have a moderate ground army with Zerglings, Hydralisks, and Queens, and moderate technology.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when your army is comparable to the opponent's and you have a good economy. If the opponent transitions to air, consider adding anti-air or switching to air yourself.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, continue economy and production, maintain defense, consider tech.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen your ground army to match the opponent's composition. Continue developing your economy and production. Maintain your defense and consider increasing your technology to get better units.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Strengthening
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-invest in a single unit composition without scouting; maintain flexibility to adapt to opponent's tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the late-midgame, the opponent has a heavy ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, and heavy production and moderate technology. You have a heavy ground army with Zerglings and Queens, and heavy production and moderate technology.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a strong army and economy. If the opponent transitions to air, consider adding anti-air or switching to air yourself.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, maintain production, consider tech, strong defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain your heavy production. Consider increasing your technology to get better units like Roaches or Hydralisks. Keep your defense strong.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Dominance
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if the opponent transitions to air; maintain a balanced composition to avoid being caught off guard.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
